environment.description: Same application deployed in namespace 'reporting-svc' on the same GKE cluster. Istio 1.19 sidecar injected (istio-proxy envoy). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action for requests where source.namespace is NOT in ['reporting-svc', 'istio-system']. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action requires requests to '/api/*' paths to carry a valid RequestAuthentication JWT issued by the cluster's internal OIDC provider (bound to ServiceAccount 'report-consumer' in namespace 'reporting-svc' only). The '/internal/metrics' path has a separate DENY policy blocking all traffic where the source principal does not match 'cluster.local/ns/monitoring/sa/prometheus'. Note: the format string processing still occurs for any request that passes the mesh authorization layer, but cross-namespace attackers and unauthenticated callers cannot reach the vulnerable endpoints.
